context: Ongoing: Vent path sizing and cell spacing to contain a single-cell runaway. This week: Vent channel sizing debated; burst plate at 0.5 bar vs open slots.
Ongoing: FOC rewrite with a thermal model and derating for DVT actuators. This week: Mei worries derate will cut torque mid-step and drop the leg.
Ongoing: Tendons fray at the proximal pulley after 40k grip cycles
Ongoing: Backlash in the rev B cycloidal reducer and whether to shim or re-grind. This week: Dyno shows 0.4 deg backlash on two of three rev B units, twice spec.
Ongoing: What to show investors when no full humanoid exists
Ongoing: Harness conductors breaking at the knee after ~15k flex cycles. This week: Interim: machined strain-relief clamp and service loop; leg rev C routing planned.
Ongoing: Gait controller tuning for the investor demo on the gait gantry. This week: Dress rehearsal: 2 minutes continuous walking; demo plan locked.
Ongoing: Gate driver ringing and current sense offset on the motor driver. This week: Rev 4 boards arrive; ringing down to 9 V overshoot.
Ongoing: Spend running ahead of plan; push to stop default expedites. This week: Gwen proposes expedite only with a stated need date; engineers grumble.
Ongoing: Too many life tests for one grip fixture and one dyno
Ongoing: Whether to machine pelvis plates from 7075 or wait for a casting
